faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Ahmedabad Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIPER Ahmedabad is 06 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M. Pharm/ MS Pharm/ MSc or Equivalent with specialization in Medicinal Chemistry/Organic Chemistry or equivalent. A PG degree with 60% marks for GN/OBC (55% for SC/ST/PH) from a UGC recognized University/ Institute, autonomous bodies NIPER/IITs/IISER is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 23,213/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIPER Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of NIPER Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q7. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a screening process, an interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at NIPER Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
